section_summary.extract_value: This Procedures section states that two studies (referred to as Sample 1 and Sample 2) used very similar procedures: data were collected online via Qualtrics and participants were recruited through social media and e-mail listservs. The inclusion criteria required participants to identify as women and be over 18; an online study information sheet served as consent and no contact information was collected to preserve anonymity.
section_summary.evidence_source: For both studies data collection and recruitment mechanisms were very similar. In brief, data were collected online using Qualtrics and participants were recruited through social media websites and e-mail list serves. The inclusion criteria for both studies were that potential participants identified as women and were over the age of 18.
